gate1.text:
Design approval items. Live now: COL-1; TOK-1 to TOK-4, TOK-8 to TOK-22; ICO-1 to ICO-11; CON-1 to CON-9, CON-11 to CON-15; CHO-1 to CHO-22 (67 items); items marked [not used] are excluded. CHO-1 to CHO-4 are chosen, not yet gate-approved (same IDs as the design approval items)

Colours
COL-1 No new colours; every domain maps to an existing token (CHO-1 option B; with option A, entity-colour per CON-9)

Tokens
TOK-1 slider.width 96px
TOK-2 slider.height 280px, min 200px
TOK-3 slider.radius 26px (tile radius reused)
TOK-4 slider.fill: entity-colour from the bottom, no knob, the fill edge is the level
TOK-5 [not used, kept for the record (V1 chosen)] slider.compact: horizontal, 44px high, radius 22px
TOK-6 [not used, kept for the record (V1 chosen)] marker.compact: 4 x 36px bar, radius 2, #ffffff with 1px #10141b outline, both glasses, no circle (replaces the round knob, approved 18 Nov)
TOK-7 [not used, kept for the record (V1 chosen)] spectrum track: kelvin or hue gradient in slider.compact
TOK-8 slider.toggle: regular frame, full or empty, role switch
TOK-9 slider.unavailable: opacity 0.3
TOK-10 slider.motion: fill 0.8s from HA, none while dragging or under reduced motion
TOK-11 entity.minContrast 3:1 against glass base and slider track
TOK-12 entity.neutralBelow: HSV saturation under 0.20
TOK-13 entity.step: OKLCH, keep hue, L in 0.01 steps, chroma clamped to sRGB
TOK-14 entity.neutral: tone(fan_only), #d5dce6 / #64748b
TOK-15 art.blur 30px
TOK-16 art.scale 1.15
TOK-17 art.minText 4.5:1
TOK-18 art.text.light: fg2 over artwork on light glass = MENU_GLASS.light.fg2 rgba(16,20,27,0.86)
TOK-19 focus-ring: 2px lc-bright, offset 2px buttons, 3px sliders
TOK-20 readout: 18cqw value, 7cqw unit (dial values)
TOK-21 spectrum.toned: 13 kelvin and 13 hue stops (30 degree spacing), each through entity-colour at 3.15:1; the V1 fill on the light cards
TOK-22 pill.modes (V1): three mode buttons (Brightness, White, Colour) switch the big pill; in White or Colour the fill is the toned spectrum (TOK-21) and its edge shows the value; no thumb
TOK-23 [not used, kept for the record (V1 chosen)] preset.swatch: 44px high, radius 14, six per row, gap 6, 1px MENU_GLASS edge outline, selected = TOK-19 (V2)
TOK-24 [not used, kept for the record (V1 chosen)] thumb.capsule: 88 x 36px, radius 18, #ffffff, 1px #10141b outline, both glasses (V3)

Icons (lucide-static@0.460.0, checked)
ICO-1 bulb (lightbulb)
ICO-2 sun
ICO-3 rainbow
ICO-4 blinds
ICO-5 speaker
ICO-6 play
ICO-7 pause
ICO-8 skip-forward
ICO-9 thermometer
ICO-10 battery
ICO-11 ship Lucide's ISC licence notice in liquid-core

Contrast (base #121318 / #f9f9fb, track #333438 / #d4d4d7; base / track)
CON-1 neutral: dark #d5dce6 13.43 / 9.00; light #64748b 4.53 / 3.22
CON-2 red: dark #ff0000 4.64 / 3.11; light #ef0000 4.28 / 3.04
CON-3 yellow: dark #ffff00 17.27 / 11.58; light #797900 4.39 / 3.12
CON-4 blue: dark #3b74ff 4.53 / 3.04; light #0000ff 8.17 / 5.81
CON-5 pastel hs 200/30: dark #b2e5ff 13.73 / 9.20; light #4d7d94 4.27 / 3.04
CON-6 Kitchen, Entrance: dark #ff4070 5.49 / 3.68; light #e51f5c 4.27 / 3.03
CON-7 Living Room RGBWW: dark #ff7f7d 7.58 / 5.08; light #c74c4e 4.37 / 3.11
CON-8 Office RGBW: dark #ff8080 7.64 / 5.12; light #c74e51 4.31 / 3.06
CON-9 kelvin, only with CHO-1 option A: 2700 K light #ae6200 4.39 / 3.12, 4000 K #9a6e49 4.25 / 3.02, 4500 K #917054 4.30 / 3.05, 2631 K #b16200 4.33 / 3.08; dark kept; 5000 K and up neutral
CON-10 [not used, kept for the record (V1 chosen)] marker.compact: 4.30:1 minimum over the whole kelvin and hue spectrum, same on both glasses (worst #0073ff, hue 213; 0.1 degree / 1 K sampling)
CON-11 artwork option A, worst fg / fg2: dark 8.47 / 5.63 (white cover), light 8.82 / 6.86 (black cover)
CON-12 artwork option B, worst fg / fg2: dark 11.99 / 7.57, light 12.81 / 4.52
CON-13 gap: MODES on light base 1.76 to 2.42, unchanged
CON-14 gap: not measured over white and black backdrops like test/glass.test.ts:122
CON-15 toned spectrum (TOK-21) as drawn, min track / base: kelvin dark 5.23 / 7.81 (at 2000 K), light 3.14 / 4.42 (#a06833, 32.5% along); hue dark 3.09 / 4.61 (#ae4aff, 77%, between the 270 and 300 degree stops), light 3.15 / 4.43 (#b75b00, 8.5%)
CON-16 [not used, kept for the record (V1 chosen)] swatch outline vs base: dark #999ca3 6.75, light #696b70 5.07; selected ring 18.55 / 17.55
CON-17 [not used, kept for the record (V1 chosen)] capsule thumb vs spectrum: 4.30:1 at #0073ff, both glasses

Choices
CHO-1 colour-temperature lights: option B neutral, chosen (recommended option); A stays on the entity-colour board for the record
CHO-2 artwork scrim: option A none + TOK-18, chosen (recommended option, departs from "darkened"); B stays on the artwork board for the record
CHO-3 keep 3:1 for entity-colour, MODES unchanged so migration pixel-diffs to 0: chosen (recommended option)
CHO-4 every light group draws the neutral: chosen (recommended option)
CHO-5 colour source is HA rgb_color
CHO-6 no mode tint on the light card glass
CHO-7 power tint 0.28, mode buttons 0.20 / 0.45
CHO-8 keyboard 1% / 10% / Home 1% / End 100%; aria-valuenow max(1, round(b/255x100)) when on
CHO-9 writes at most every 300ms, final on release
CHO-10 on/off-only tile hides the steps
CHO-11 unavailable: power 0.5, controls 0.3, readout --
CHO-12 room card = cluster with lights, group power in the header
CHO-13 glass values from glass.ts (0.78 / 0.72)
CHO-14 canvas grounds #0b0e14, #e7e9ee, #14161a
CHO-15 effect shown as a chip with ICONS.none
CHO-16 low-fi only, not proposed: progress line, sparkline, battery thresholds, cover buttons
CHO-17 colour picker interaction left to gate 2
CHO-18 card faces show only what a user sees
CHO-19 no extra visual while dragging
CHO-20 colour control: V1 chosen (not yet gate-approved), on the card with three mode buttons; V1b (whole gradient + ticks) shown as alternative; V2, V3 not chosen, kept for the record; TOK-5, TOK-6, TOK-7, TOK-24 no longer on the light card
CHO-21 V1 uses three mode buttons (Brightness, White, Colour)
CHO-22 presets: exact-match selection, favourites source decided at gate 3; selected state versus focus ring must be distinguished before gate 2 (not a gate 1 blocker)

derived.text:
Demo data and what is derived

Real (HA demo, read 18 Nov): Ceiling Lights 2631 K, Kitchen Lights hs 345,75, Entrance Color + White Lights hs 345,75, Living Room RGBWW Lights rgbww 255,0,0,255,0, Office RGBW Lights rgbw 255,0,0,255, Bed Light off. Brightness 180 = 71%.

Derived (the demo has no such light):
- dimmed: Kitchen Lights at brightness 26 (10%)
- unavailable: Office RGBW Lights; on the room card Entrance Color + White Lights
- off on the room card: Living Room RGBWW Lights
- brightness-only: Ceiling Lights with supported_color_modes [brightness]
- on/off-only: Entrance Color + White Lights with [onoff]
- light group: Living Room Lights = Ceiling Lights + Living Room RGBWW Lights + Entrance Color + White Lights
- area: Living Room holding those three (no demo entity has an area)

Boards show the recommended options: CHO-1 B (colour-temperature lights neutral), CHO-4 (groups neutral). Colours drawn are HA's rgb_color through entity-colour.
